statusLine.command: c=$(tput bold; tput setaf 6); y=$(tput setaf 3); g=$(tput setaf 2); d=$(tput setaf 8); r=$(tput sgr0); v=$(jq -r 'def ts: if type=="string" then fromdateiso8601 else . end; def left: if . == null then "" else (ts - now) as $s | if $s <= 0 then "now" else (($s/3600)|floor) as $h | ((($s%3600)/60)|floor) as $m | if $h > 0 then "\($h)h\($m)m" else "\($m)m" end end end; [ .model.display_name // "?", .effort.level // "", ((.cost.total_cost_usd // 0)|tostring), (if .rate_limits.five_hour then (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage|round|tostring) else "" end), (.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // null | left) ] | @tsv'); IFS=$'\t' read -r model effort cost pct left <<< "$v"; out="${c}${model}${r}"; [ -n "$effort" ] && out="$out  ${y}${effort}${r}"; out="$out  ${g}\$$(printf '%.2f' "$cost")${r}"; [ -n "$pct" ] && out="$out  ${d}${pct}% · ${left}${r}"; printf '%s\n' "$out"
